editorial:
Imagine being a total control freak who suddenly finds out exactly what every teenager around him is thinking. That is the wild ride you get with Christophe, a grieving widower who tries to bond with his son, Victor, by volunteering at a snowy holiday camp. He thinks he has everything under control, but he quickly realizes that being a dad is way harder than managing a schedule. The movie has a cozy, festive feel that makes you want to curl up with a blanket, and the chemistry between the characters keeps things light and breezy.

You will love how the mind-reading power adds a funny twist to the usual family drama, though some parts of the plot move a bit slowly. The acting is natural and heartwarming, making the emotional moments actually land. If you are looking for a feel-good story, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for future family movie nights. It is a sweet, simple flick that does not ask too much of you.
endingExplained: After using his powers to help the kids and fix his relationship with Victor, Christophe eventually loses the ability to hear thoughts. He realizes he does not need a superpower to be a good father; he just needs to listen and be present. He finds love with Marina, the biology teacher, and the movie ends with the family finally feeling whole again. It wraps up as a happy story about letting go of control and embracing love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cozy family comedies and magical twists.
